mechanism: Nalmefene is an opioid antagonist that blocks mu-receptor mediated effects; paroxetine is an SSRI; concurrent use presents theoretical serotonin syndrome risk and potential reduced efficacy if nalmefene is used for alcohol use disorder treatment due to CNS depression interactions.
action: Use combination cautiously with close monitoring for serotonergic symptoms; nalmefene may reduce SSRI efficacy in some contexts; consider alternative opioid antagonist or ensure appropriate clinical indication for nalmefene use.
